calls.statement:
WITH l AS (
  SELECT f.*, s.store_id, s.format, p.category
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4 AND s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test')
SELECT format, count(distinct store_id) stores, count(distinct receipt_id) receipts, sum(net_amount) net, round(sum(net_amount)/count(distinct receipt_id),2) atv_all,
 count(distinct receipt_id) FILTER (WHERE NOT staff_purchase_flag) r_ns,
 sum(net_amount) FILTER (WHERE NOT staff_purchase_flag) net_ns,
 round(sum(net_amount) FILTER (WHERE NOT staff_purchase_flag)/count(distinct receipt_id) FILTER (WHERE NOT staff_purchase_flag),2) atv,
 count(distinct receipt_id) FILTER (WHERE staff_purchase_flag) r_staff
FROM l GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH l AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, f.net_amount, f.receipt_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'),
a AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_amount) n, count(distinct receipt_id) r FROM l GROUP BY 1),
b AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) n, sum(receipts) r FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND store_id<900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) stores, sum(a.n) wh, sum(b.n) rpt, count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(a.n-b.n)>0.5) mism_net, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.r<>b.r) mism_rec,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM a) na, (SELECT count(*) FROM b) nb
FROM a FULL JOIN b USING(store_id)
